name: Sitri
source:
He has acute hearing and is a leader who senses and prepares against dangerous situations faster than anyone else. Still, he has the hobby of listening to the enemy's last heartbeats and enjoying tea even during battle.
Sitri is the devil that Satan trusts the most. Sitri contacts Satan often, worried that Satan might need his blood.
